sections.text_helper: Section 6.10.10 "FLASH HDP extension register (FLASH_HDPEXTR)" in chapter 6 (Embedded flash memory (FLASH)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 184.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x048
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
This register can be protected against unprivileged access when PRIV = 1
inFLASH_PRIVCFGR. The register can only be modified in HDPL ≤ 2.
The values in this register cannot be decremented. Attempt to write a lower value that
current is ignored.
Bits 31:22 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 21:16 HDP2_EXT[5:0]: HDP area extension in 8-Kbyte pages in bank2
Extension is added after the HDP2_END page (included).
Bits 15:6 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 5:0 HDP1_EXT[5:0]: HDP area extension in 8-Kbyte pages in bank1
Extension is added after the HDP1_END page (included).
